title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT’s plugins with app-like interfaces and automations
slides: OpenAI just turned ChatGPT into an app platform?
Plugins now get custom interfaces and automations
But most users will never see them
Developers can now build full workflows inside chat
thread_text:
1. ChatGPT becomes a platform

OpenAI just gave ChatGPT custom interfaces and automations for plugins, turning it into an app platform. Most users won't see them yet.

2. Plugins get superpowers

Developers can now build full workflows inside chat, with custom UIs and automation triggers. This means tasks run without leaving the conversation.

3. The invisible update

These new features are rolling out quietly. Unless you dig into settings, you might miss them entirely.

4. Workflows in chat

Imagine booking a flight, filing expenses, and updating your CRM without switching tabs. That's the promise, but it's early days.

5. Check your settings tomorrow

Open ChatGPT and look for new plugin options. Try one automation on a simple task. If you don't see it, wait a day.

instagram.caption:
Plugins can now have custom interfaces and run automations inside the chat, a bit like mini apps living in ChatGPT.

OpenAI is turning ChatGPT into an app platform, so developers can build full workflows that run without leaving the conversation.

You might miss the whole thing: the update is rolling out quietly. 🧩

If you publish or build, this is where your tools could soon live, not in a separate tab.

Open ChatGPT, check your plugin settings, and try one automation on a simple task. Do you see it, or do you have to wait a day? 👀
